units: Dimensionless shares of centered squared/fourth residual sums; normalized stage residuals; crop and native pixel coordinates.
limitations: Selection uses outcome ranks: attribution oracle, not deployable defect detector. Rank fractions fixed, not production thresholds. Same-coordinate traces do not prove CFA-to-RGB one-pixel causality; RCD uses neighborhoods and channels. Pair differences remove common defects; recurrent ranks are not proof of hot pixels. Same-session repeated inspection, no independent image-quality validation, no pixel removal, RAW decode, production change or final reserve access.
